conditions.E: existing graph-first top-5 operational slot refinement; graph score unchanged

debugger_status.contract: subject/equivalent return debugger-presence truth; foil returns its complement. Same stable OS debugger state across comparisons. No anti-analysis branch or evasion is implemented.
debugger_status.negative: Same API, same observation, opposite returned truth. Intended observable collision, not a claimed ability to infer return semantics.

resource_module.contract: subject/equivalent load version.dll as a data file and test whether version resource 1 has nonzero size; foil targets kernel32.dll. Assumes stable OS library contents/availability. Labels refer to resource identity, not equality of success booleans.
resource_module.negative: Same resource-access API sequence and graph shape, distinct file-name observation.

socket_lifecycle.contract: subject/equivalent create and close an IPv4 TCP socket; foil creates and closes an IPv4 UDP socket. No connect, send, receive or external endpoint. Assumes initialized Winsock and stable resource availability; source contracts specify requested socket kind, not success alone.
socket_lifecycle.negative: Same socket/close API sequence, different protocol/type operands. Tests information absent from graph evidence rather than assuming constants are recovered.

labels: source-contract: subject/equivalent positive; foil distinct; no labels from scores
limitations: only three correlated authored families; exploratory heldout family transfer, not representative malware generalization
missingness: record expected region coverage and all seeds; fail evaluation on an unrepresented expected region rather than silently discard it
partitions: one distinct authored functional source lineage per split; shared includes/test harness/CRT documented, no claim of external independent annotation
safety: benign programs; no target execution, network communication or security changes
threshold: discovery only; no parameter/weight/feature tuning after heldout

unavailable_families.debugger_status: Bitdefender quarantine confirmed by user; binary not read or executed; discovery unavailable
